# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

Use this section to tell people about which versions of your project are
currently being supported with security updates.

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| 0.1.x   | :white_check_mark: |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please use [GitHub's vulnerability reporting tools](https://github.com/gwynne/rollup-plugin-niceprogressbar/security) to report security issues. Vulnerabilities will be addressed as quickly as possible based on maintainer availability.
